verdict.rationale: LangSmith documents its own background automations: rules, webhooks, and online evaluators that run automatically on production traces with filters and sampling, plus threshold alerts and LangSmith Engine, which automatically detects recurring issues. However, these automations are scoped to trace monitoring and evaluation rather than general-purpose autonomous workflows, and the rules feature appears only in a one-line mention. Missing for 10: documented detail on automation rule configuration and actions, scheduled or recurring triggers beyond trace events, general-purpose background workflows, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background

citations.quote: Automate workflows with rules, webhooks, and online evaluations.
Set up evaluators to run automatically on production traces: safety checks, format validation, quality heuristics, and reference-free LLM-as-judge. Apply filters and sampling rates to control costs.
Automatically detect recurring issues in your traces, diagnose their root cause, and resolve them with LangSmith Engine.
LangSmith provides threshold-based alerting on the following metrics: Run Count, Cost, Errors, Feedback Score, Latency
